text: Uh, if you don't mind, Mrs. Cooper, there's a 305 nonstop back to Los Angeles, and you have no idea how much I want to be on it.

text: That girl? Oh, good. I've been praying for you. Sheldon.

text: I forgive you. Let's go home.

text: How about that? You finally caught a break. You know how they say when friends have sex, it can get weird? Why does it have to get weird?
